mmap_recheck.ratio_policy: Same cohort, same logical work and physical group size; one complete SQLite configuration selected by completion for all metrics.
mmap_recheck.qualification: Seven-run observational medians with separate probes. Controls assess harness changes only; cross-engine ratios are not a 5% regression qualification.

append_only.qualification: Separate implementation and fixed 30-round phase-check cohorts. Identical-binary controls and all phase alerts retained; no universal zero-overhead or 5% guarantee.
append_only.runtime_notes: primary-v1 used the earlier resource-options replacement API with fully resolved FULL limits. primary-v2 and both calibrations use open_reader_with_resource_limits and preserve missing format defaults. primary-final-v1 additionally includes metadata-only mmap Debug formatting and predates lifecycle-v1. lifecycle-v1 compares the c5 guarded baseline with current guarded operation and actual reader-first repeated writer leases. lifecycle-calibration-v1 retains fixed 30-round before A/B/current phase checks. lifecycle-oom-cleanup-v1 compares 09c2028 with the final observer-free cleanup fix using identical Rust harness sources; lifecycle-oom-calibration-v1 keeps its four fixed 30-round phase checks separate. No cohort pooling.
append_only.scope: One process, one active writer and independent reader threads; live per-record windows or two-pass fixed snapshots. No new SQLite/HDF5 comparison.
